versions.changelog: clawdbot metadata (category, emoji, tags, requires), user-invocable, free discovery block

- Updated homepage URL in SKILL.md.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

Initial release of defi-diligence skill.

- Offers quick risk screening for any Base or Solana token by symbol or contract address.
- Returns PASS, WATCH, or FLAG verdict and detects critical risk "kill switches" (honeypot, high tax, mint/freeze authority).
- Auto-scores liquidity, volume, holder concentration, contract age, and price change.
- Provides a $2 USDC payment path via x402 to unlock the full scored report.
- Exposes an MCP tool at /mcp and a direct API at /v1/products/defi-diligence/score.
